author: Porkyyy
body:
Hey everyone! So basically, I want to make a few changes to my channel, and that includes changing my channel icon.
Currently, my icon looks like this:


Anyways, I want to know if anyone can do (or knows someone who can do) something more like this:
   

Something alone the lines of those "animated" logos.

The reason for this is because I want to make some changes to my YouTube channel, and this is one of those changes.

AS FOR THE PRIZE...
If you don't want a prize, that's okay with me, but if you do, here is what you get:
- 5000 credits to the account of your choice
- A shoutout in one of my next videos which will be specifically for the channel update; I'll mention your name (or the name of the creator if you know someone) and what you helped make for me.

Thanks a lot guys, and remember that if you ask someone else to make it for me, you'll still get a shoutout as well as the person who makes it.
